input.answer: From what I read, a keren hishtalmut is savings that my employer and I both pay into from my salary. After 6 years I can take it out with no tax, and before that I pay tax. With the employer adding 7.5% it sounds worth having, but the page says "המדינה לא ערבה" and that the value goes up and down. So before I sign anything I'll ask you and the bank which track is safe.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the row under the subtitle
stuck.why: "123 מקור 123 חושב 123 הזנה" and "לחצו על מספר כדי לראות מאיפה הוא". I didn't know what those 123s were and I didn't click.

stuck.where: Screen 2, the calculator with the big bars
stuck.why: Too many numbers and colours. The red "−13,974 ₪" with the stripes scared me, and I couldn't tell the yellow and brown bars apart.
"מסלול מדד", "מדד S&P500", "מיטב". English letters and a fund tied to the stock exchange. That's exactly what burned me before.
"המדינה לא ערבה לשווי הקרן, והוא עולה ויורד". It worried me, and I stopped reading soon after.
